rocksdb_hash_behavior.note: NOT pinned here — the authoritative packet is dd12m54's open PR #3525 (RE-001-hash-entry-61c34a0-115). Recorded here only as the record host's callee (seed 397 = 0x18d) so the model can compute the stored hash
rocksdb_hash_behavior.signature: hash(const char *data, size_t len, u32 seed) -> u32
steps: h = (len * 0xc6a4a793) ^ seed (32-bit)
for each full 4-byte word w (little-endian): h += w; h = (h * 0xc6a4a793) ^ ((h * 0xc6a4a793) >> 16)
tail of 1-3 bytes: h += (int8)data[k] << (8*k) for each remaining byte, low byte first; then h = (h * 0xc6a4a793) ^ ((h * 0xc6a4a793) >> 24)
a length that is a multiple of 4 returns h with no final mix
empty input returns the seed (397 at the record host's call site)

serializer_behavior.layout: [varint bucket_count][varint key_count][bucket_count x u32 slots][suffix area: per multi-entry bucket, varint(count) + count x u32 arg4 in reverse chain order]
steps: log level 0 via 0x5fceda0(logger at +0x228, "[%s:156] Reserving %u bytes for plain table's sub_index", file, *(this+0x774)) — the %u is the suffix-map payload size, not the total reservation (see README)
total = varint_len(*(this+0x770)) + varint_len(*(this+0x75c)) + *(this+0x774) + *(this+0x770)*4
buffer = (*owner)->vtable[0x18](*owner, total, *(this+0x788), logger at +0x228) (see open_unknowns)
write varint32(*(this+0x770)) then varint32(*(this+0x75c)) at the buffer start via 0x61bd410

for each bucket i in 0..*(this+0x770)-1: if counts[i] == 0, slot[i] = 0x7fffffff; if counts[i] == 1, slot[i] = heads[i]->arg4; if counts[i] > 1, slot[i] = suffix_offset | 0x80000000 and the suffix area at suffix_base + suffix_offset gets varint32(counts[i]) followed by the chain's arg4 values in REVERSE chain order (head last), then suffix_offset += varint_len(counts[i]) + counts[i]*4
log level 0 via 0x5fceda0(logger, "[%s:202] hash table size: %u, suffix_map length %u", file, *(this+0x770), *(this+0x774))
return (buffer, total)
serializer_behavior.suffix_order_note: the gather prepends entries, so each chain is in reverse insertion order; the serializer walks the chain head-first into the suffix from the last slot backwards, so the suffix lists each bucket's values in insertion order

subrec_append_behavior.entry_layout: {u32 hash (+0x00), u32 arg4 (+0x04), u64 next (+0x08)} — 16 bytes; next is the chain link written by the gather, always 0 here
subrec_append_behavior.fast_path: if *(s+0x28) != *(s+0x00): store {hash, arg4, 0} at current_chunk + *(s+0x28)*16 and increment *(s+0x28)
growth_path: when the current chunk is full (*(s+0x28) == *(s+0x00)): if *(s+0x28) >> 59 != 0 jump to the throw stub 0x6198776 (__cxa_throw_bad_array_new_length)
allocate a new chunk of *(s+0x00)*16 bytes via operator new[]
if chunk_ptrs.end != chunk_ptrs.capacity_end, store the new chunk at *end and advance end (inlined push_back); otherwise call 0x61985f0(&chunk_ptrs, &new_chunk) (the reallocating push_back slow path)
current_chunk = new chunk; *(s+0x28) = 1; store the entry at chunk+0

store_layout.+0x00: entries per chunk (u64, the chunk capacity)
store_layout.+0x28: entries used in the current (last) chunk (u64)

steps: canary check on the caller's frame; on failure call __stack_chk_fail
otherwise call __cxa_throw_bad_array_new_length (no return)
the entry adds 8 to the histogram argument and calls the renderer 0x606b6f0, which builds the text into a fresh string and returns it
line 1 (always): "Count: %lu Average: %.4f  StdDev: %.2f\n" (count, sum/count or 0.0, stddev or 0.0)
line 2: "Min: %lu  Median: %.4f  Max: %lu\n" (min/max fields, literal 0/0 when empty; median is Percentile(50.0))
line 4: 54 dashes + "\n" (55 bytes)

one row per non-empty bucket: "%c %7lu, %7lu ] %8lu %7.3f%% %7.3f%% " ('[' with lower 0 for bucket 0, '(' with lower BOUNDARIES[i-1] otherwise; upper BOUNDARIES[i]; count; bucket percent; cumulative percent) then '#' repeated round(bucket_pct / 5) times, then "\n"

percentile(pct) = threshold count*(pct/100.0); walk buckets until the running total strictly exceeds it (the signed path jumps only on running > threshold, so a threshold landing exactly on a bucket boundary continues to the next non-empty bucket and skips any empty bucket's range); value = lower + ((threshold - prev_cum) / bucket_count) * (upper - lower); an empty bucket returns its lower boundary; past the last bucket returns (double)max
average = 0.0 when count is 0, else sum / count; stddev = 0.0 when count is 0, else sqrt(max(0, (count*sumSq - sum*sum) / count*count))

unsigned LEB128: value <= 0x7f -> 1 byte; <= 0x3fff -> 2 bytes; <= 0x1fffff -> 3 bytes; <= 0xfffffff -> 4 bytes; else 5 bytes; every byte but the last carries the 0x80 continuation bit; returns dst + length
